intro: Turbo Play is an unusual Wazdan catalogue entry: a three-reel slot with just one line. Instead of numerous Scatters, it gives the player Reels Blocking, allowing two reels to be held for the next spin.
The Wild appears only on the third reel and substitutes for one of five low-paying symbols. It should not be assigned universal substitution for every symbol.
wazdan-turbo-play.editorial: Turbo Play's key choice is holding two reels rather than line count: its single line makes each result particularly dependent on the specific trio.

features.title: Reels Blocking for two reels
features.description: Two selected reels can be locked while the remaining reel spins again.

features.title: Wild only on the third reel
features.description: Substitutes for one of five low-paying symbols rather than acting as a full Wild across the grid.

features.title: Gamble and adjustable volatility
features.description: Additional post-win risk and profile selection do not change the single base line.

intro: Lord Merlin and The Lady of The Lake uses a 5×3 grid and 10 lines. Three or more Excalibur Scatters trigger 8 Free Spins, with a Special Expanding Symbol selected before each stage.

During Free Spins, Excalibur also becomes a Wild Scatter. Two Excaliburs trigger Nested Free Spins: the current sequence pauses, the selected expanding symbol locks, and repeated pairs of Excaliburs can extend the nested bonus.
playn-go-lord-merlin-and-the-lady-of-the.editorial: This Merlin version's distinction is its bonus-within-a-bonus structure. Nested Free Spins does not replace the main sequence but temporarily sits inside it, retaining the selected expanding symbol.

features.title: Excalibur Free Spins
features.description: Three or more Excaliburs trigger eight spins, while Excalibur itself acts as a Wild Scatter during the bonus.

features.title: Special Expanding Symbol
features.description: A random regular symbol becomes special and can expand across a whole reel when enough matches are present.

features.title: Nested Free Spins
features.description: Two Excaliburs inside the bonus open a nested sequence with the expanding symbol locked; another two can extend it again.

intro: Unicorn Reels begins on five reels with ten lines, but five Unicorn symbols trigger a separate Unicorn Jackpot Game on a 5×5 grid.
During the bonus, three respins reset after every new unicorn. Fifteen collected symbols award Minor 100x, twenty award Major 300x, and a full grid of 25 unicorns awards Grand 1000x.
wazdan-unicorn-reels.editorial: Unicorn Reels' jackpot mode is different from Free Spins: accumulation awards fixed tiers at 15/20/25 unicorns, while the regular Wild has a base-game role.

features.title: Five unicorns trigger the bonus
features.description: The corresponding symbol condition starts a standalone 5×5 matrix.

features.title: Three replenishing respins
features.description: Every new unicorn resets the respin counter, allowing accumulation to continue.

features.title: Tiers 100x / 300x / 1000x
features.description: Collecting 15, 20 or 25 unicorns makes Minor, Major or Grand Jackpot available respectively.

intro: Lordi Reel Monsters is built as a 7×7 grid, where band members destroy matching symbols and each character handles its own effect. This is not a regular line structure.

Charge Metre and Free Spins form the main progression. On entering Free Spins, the player chooses one of two Lordi songs, with the choice determining presentation and the course of the bonus sequence.
playn-go-lordi-reel-monsters.editorial: Lordi Reel Monsters embeds its music theme into the mechanics rather than attaching it on top: song selection happens immediately before Free Spins, while band-member functions operate on the grid.

features.title: 7×7 grid
features.description: Matching symbols are destroyed on a large grid, while different Lordi members trigger their own effects.

features.title: Charge Metre
features.description: The charge meter participates in round progression and leads to enhanced game events.

features.title: Song choice during Free Spins
features.description: One of two Lordi tracks is selected before the bonus, after which the sequence unfolds on the grid.

intro: Valentine’s Coins uses nine positions on 3×3 rather than line play. Love the Jackpot works through respins that lock landed money symbols.
Love Infinity remains on the reels during the base game and persists until the next bonus ends. A full grid awards Grand, with intermediate tiers represented by Mini, Minor and Major.
wazdan-valentines-coins.editorial: This romantic version's Love Infinity should not be described as Sizzling Eggs' Collect to Infinity: the former locks base-game symbols, while the latter extends a Collector during Free Spins.

features.title: Love Infinity until the bonus ends
features.description: Symbols can persist on the grid in the base game and remain active until Love the Jackpot finishes.

features.title: Love the Jackpot on 3×3
features.description: New money symbols stay during the bonus and replenish remaining respins.

features.title: Mini, Minor, Major and Grand
features.description: The three lower tiers pay through their corresponding prize symbols, while a full matrix opens Grand.

intro: Love is in the Fair uses a 5×3 grid and a persistent Love Map. Romantic Pics move the couple around the fairground map and unlock increasingly strong multiplier levels.

A Love Cam Wild can appear with a multiplier up to x100. Three or more Scatters trigger Free Spins, while every additional three Romantic Pics during the bonus add spins and raise the available multiplier.
playn-go-love-is-in-the-fair.editorial: The Love Map connects long-term progression and Free Spins: the same Romantic Pics that advance the map simultaneously extend the bonus sequence and raise its multiplier.

features.title: Love Map
features.description: Romantic Pics retain map progress and sequentially unlock multiplier levels up to x100.

features.title: Love Cam Wild
features.description: The Wild can arrive with x2, x3, x5, x10 or x100 multipliers and enhance the qualifying combination.

features.title: Free Spins
features.description: Three Scatters trigger the bonus; every three additional Romantic Pics add three spins and move the multiplier to the next level.

intro: Valhalla unfolds its Norse story on four reels with 54 lines. Unlike most Wazdan line slots, payouts can form in both directions, starting from either the left or right edge.
The Valkyrie Wild substitutes for regular symbols; a separate risk game choosing Norse doors opens after a winning spin. The official maximum is 600x rather than a two-way line multiplier.
wazdan-valhalla.editorial: The main distinction is the unusual two-way calculation of 54 lines. There is no basis to add Free Spins or Hold the Jackpot: Valhalla confirms a Wild, lines in both directions and a risk game.

features.title: 54 lines in two directions
features.description: Combinations pay from either the first or fourth reel when line conditions are met.

features.title: Valkyrie Wild
features.description: The special heroine substitutes for regular symbols and helps form a line combination.

features.title: Door Gamble
features.description: After a win, a door can be selected to risk an awarded prize for a double; this event is separate from the spin.

intro: Love Joker runs on a compact 3×3 grid. A Love Joker Scatter triggers Love Re-Spins, while Hearts and Golden Hearts collect separately above the reels.
Five regular Hearts increase the current multiplier, while Golden Hearts double it. The re-spin sequence therefore depends both on landed symbols and heart accumulation above the grid.
playn-go-love-joker.editorial: Love Joker differs completely from Love is in the Fair: there is no Love Map. Its central system is Love Re-Spins and two Heart categories that enhance the multiplier differently.

features.title: Love Re-Spins
features.description: A Love Joker Scatter triggers re-spins in which heart collection continues.

features.title: Regular Hearts
features.description: Collected Hearts accumulate above the reels; every five increase the current multiplier.

features.title: Golden Hearts
features.description: A Golden Heart does more than add to a counter: it doubles the sequence's current multiplier.

intro: Vegas Hot retains three reels and just five lines: compact fruit classics without additional bonus grids. Its most prominent enhancement is Wall Multiplier x2 for a qualifying complete grid fill.
A separate Gamble after a win allows several successive doubles. The provider supplies no Free Spins details for this version.
wazdan-vegas-hot.editorial: Vegas Hot should not be mixed with Vegas Hot 81: the original has only five lines and a maximum of 340x, whereas version 81 has four reels and cascades.

features.title: Five-line classic
features.description: Three reels provide traditional line combinations of fruit and sevens.

features.title: x2 Wall Multiplier
features.description: A qualifying wall of matching symbols doubles the payout, but this is not the overall top award.

features.title: Gamble up to seven doubles
features.description: The win can be risked separately in a risk game; the result is unrelated to Free Spins mechanics.

intro: Luchamigos uses a 5×4 grid paying matching symbols on adjacent reels. Three luchador characters are tied to different Wild effects.
Power Chili Spins trigger through a Luchamigo Wild and Chili Scatter combination. One hero adds a stacked Wild to a reel, the second creates a 2×2 Mega Wild, and the third places four random Wilds.
playn-go-luchamigos.editorial: A Luchamigos character determines specific Wild behaviour, so the three luchadors are not decorative versions of one symbol. The Ultimate Meter then enhances this system itself.

features.title: Power Chili Spins
features.description: A Luchamigo Wild together with a Chili Scatter opens a sequence activating the corresponding hero's ability.

features.title: Three Wild abilities
features.description: Characters award a stacked Wild, a 2×2 Mega Wild block or four Wilds at random positions.

features.title: Ultimate Meter
features.description: Filling the meter opens enhanced states, including Ultimate Hot Spin with an extra spin and a guaranteed Wild win.

intro: Vegas Hot 81 replaces the small three-reel game with four reels and 81 lines. Winning symbols disappear in Cascading Reels and give way to new ones, so one spin can produce a payout chain.
The Wild participates in new combinations and increases their multiplier under Increasing Multiplier conditions. This version's stated maximum is 5850x, several times the original Vegas Hot's.
wazdan-vegas-hot-81.editorial: The number 81 represents a different line set rather than a cosmetic Vegas Hot reissue. The five-line profile and x2 Wall should not be carried over without direct official confirmation.

features.title: 81 lines
features.description: Four reels form 81 lines rather than the original version's five.

features.title: Cascading Reels
features.description: Winning symbols disappear, and a cascade can create a new combination without another bet.

features.title: Wild Increasing Multiplier
features.description: The Wild helps form wins and raise the applicable multiplier within the cascade mechanic.

intro: Lucky Diamonds is an early three-reel slot with one line. The Diamond Wild substitutes for regular symbols and simultaneously changes the payout multiplier.
One Diamond Wild doubles a regular win, while two Diamonds increase it fourfold. Three Diamonds calculate separately under their own paytable.
playn-go-lucky-diamonds.editorial: Lucky Diamonds is a clear example of a multiplier Wild without complex bonus architecture. Its defining detail is how many Diamond Wilds participate in one line combination.

features.title: One line
features.description: The game uses three reels and one fixed line, so a result can be read without extra ways or cluster rules.

features.title: Diamond Wild x2
features.description: One Diamond Wild substitutes for a regular symbol and doubles the standard line win.

features.title: Two Diamonds x4
features.description: Two Diamond Wilds in one winning combination increase the regular payout fourfold; three Diamonds have a separate payout.

intro: Vegas Reels II stands out through a particularly narrow layout: three reels, one winning line and an unusual bonus for a losing-spin sequence.
After ten consecutive spins without a winning combination, Bonus Spins activates with an x3 multiplier. This is neither Scatter Free Spins nor Vegas Hot's Wall Multiplier.
wazdan-vegas-reels-ii.editorial: The unusual mechanic rewards a long non-winning sequence rather than three special Scatters. The overall stated maximum win of 3000x should not be treated as an award for every ten empty spins.

features.title: Single line
features.description: Payouts run along one fixed line on three reels.

features.title: Ten spins without a win
features.description: A sequence of ten non-winning spins triggers Bonus Spins under a separate rule.

features.title: Bonus Spins x3 and Gamble
features.description: The bonus multiplier triples qualifying payouts, while the post-prize risk game remains separate.

intro: Madame Ink runs on a 5×3 grid and uses two random features. Wild Ink can spill ink from a landed Wild and fill its entire reel with Wild symbols.

Madame's Mystery places a mystery symbol on the middle reel, turns it into a stack of matching high-paying symbols and changes the other such symbols on the grid into that same type. Three Scatters open a choice of three Free Spins modes.
playn-go-madame-ink.editorial: The bonus choice genuinely changes the sequence mechanic: more spins with only Wild Ink, fewer with Mystery Reel, or a short option guaranteeing both features on every spin.

features.title: Wild Ink
features.description: A randomly landed Wild can spill and turn its entire reel Wild.

features.title: Madame's Mystery
features.description: A mystery symbol on the middle reel becomes a stack of one high-paying symbol and transforms matching high-paying symbols on other reels.

features.title: Three Free Spins modes
features.description: The choices are 12 spins with only Wild Ink, 6 with only Mystery Reel, or 3 spins with both features active on every spin.

intro: Welcome To Hell 81 uses a four-reel infernal grid with 81 lines. Paid symbols disappear through Cascading Reels, and subsequent symbols land in the empty positions.

The Wild participates in winning combinations and can increase the applicable multiplier. Despite sharing the technical figures of 81 lines and 5850x with Vegas Hot 81, this is a separate game with its own symbols and presentation.
wazdan-welcome-to-hell-81.editorial: It should not be described as simply retro Vegas Hot: its theme is diabolical, with cascading wins and special Wild multipliers. The confirmed maximum of 5850x applies to the whole game.

features.title: Cascading 81 lines
features.description: Winning symbols disappear on four reels and open new combinations.

features.title: Wild Increasing Multiplier
features.description: The multiplier changes according to Wild participation in qualifying wins.

features.title: Cascade sequence
features.description: New wins can appear within one spin while paying combinations remain.

intro: Mafia Gold runs on a 5×4 grid. A Feature Reel activates when a gold-framed Mafia Boss lands in the same row, while random Drive-By can add three to eight Wilds.
Up to five Scatters award up to 20 Free Spins. During the bonus, bullets reduce four mafia members' health; each defeated character adds five spins and turns its symbol into a Mafia Boss.
playn-go-mafia-gold.editorial: Cash Hit Feature opens only after all four are defeated. The bonus therefore unfolds through step-by-step elimination of four targets rather than one standard Free Spins modifier.

features.title: Drive-By
features.description: A random feature places three to eight Wilds on the grid and changes the current round before the result is counted.

features.title: Free Spins hunt
features.description: Bullets remove 10 health units from four mafia members; each defeated character adds 5 Free Spins and becomes a Mafia Boss.

features.title: Cash Hit Feature
features.description: Defeating all four opens the Feature Reel, where golden Mafia Bosses collect safe prize values in their row.

intro: Wild Girls uses three reels with five lines, but its two heroines have different Wild roles. The redhead Wild additionally doubles a winning combination, while the brunette substitutes for regular symbols without that multiplier.
Three Mystery Symbols open a separate random prize in the provider's described range from 5x to 250x. This is not Wild Guns' Free Spins mechanic.
wazdan-wild-girls.editorial: The two Wilds are not interchangeable: x2 belongs specifically to the redhead. Game Info's top payout of 532x applies to the whole game rather than an individual Mystery.

features.title: Redhead Wild x2
features.description: Substitutes for regular symbols and doubles a win in a combination in which she participates.

features.title: Brunette Wild
features.description: Helps form winning lines without a separate x2 multiplier.

features.title: Three Mystery Symbols
features.description: Three mystery symbols open a random award; Gamble is available separately.

intro: Mahjong 88 is an 8×8 grid with cluster wins: four or more matching tiles connected vertically or horizontally are required for a payout. There are no regular cascades here: new tiles reveal beneath those that disappear.
Four Seasonal Wilds correspond to spring, summer, autumn and winter and behave differently. Winning-cluster size also charges the Mahjong Meter and leads to additional events.
playn-go-mahjong-88.editorial: Mahjong 88 should not be confused with a typical cascade-grid game. After winning tiles are removed, new elements reveal from beneath rather than falling from above in a standard cascade.

features.title: Clusters from four symbols
features.description: Groups of four or more matching tiles connected along their sides form wins on the 8×8 grid.

features.title: Seasonal Wilds
features.description: Spring, summer, autumn and winter Wilds have different effects, from adding symbols to destroying adjacent tiles and locking.

features.title: Mahjong Meter
features.description: Large winning clusters charge a meter that can open extra events, including Fortune Frog and Super Charge.

intro: Wild Guns is a cowboy slot with five reels. Technical Game Info lists five lines, although the provider's long description names ten elsewhere: the conflict must remain explicit.
Its main enhancements are Wild x2 and a random Wild tornado after a non-winning spin. The Scatter can trigger a separate Free Spins sequence.
wazdan-wild-guns.editorial: Unlike Wild Girls, this game includes random Wild additions and bonus spins. Its maximum of 850x applies to the full win rather than doubling every tornado.

features.title: Wild x2
features.description: A special Wild substitutes for regular symbols and doubles the qualifying payout.

features.title: Random Wild tornado
features.description: After an empty spin, a random effect can add a Wild and provide another chance of a combination.

features.title: Scatter and Free Spins
features.description: The Scatter opens free spins; Game Info lists five lines, while the long text says ten.

intro: Manta Mayhem centres on Pearl Collection. At most one Pearl appears per reel, collected by the Manta Ray; their visible grid history shows progress but does not itself change the next trigger probability.
Clam the Prize can randomly trigger 6, 8 or 10 Free Spins and award 3, 4 or 5 boosters. Before the bonus, the player chooses that number of pearls containing different modifiers.
playn-go-manta-mayhem.editorial: Manta Mayhem's bonus strength is set before its first Free Spin: selected boosters operate throughout the sequence. This is separate from Pearl Collection and its visual accumulation.

features.title: Pearl Collection
features.description: The ray collects Pearls; no more than one can appear on a reel, while three visible pearls display progress.

features.title: Clam the Prize
features.description: The feature assigns 6/8/10 Free Spins and 3/4/5 boosters; GO Ultra adds another spin and an extra booster.

features.title: Persistent boosters
features.description: Before the bonus, possible awards include extra spins, stacked symbols, a sticky Wild on reels 2–4, turning a symbol Wild, random Wilds or an x2/x5/x10 multiplier.

intro: Wild Jack is a three-reel game with 27 lines, where the jester Wild substitutes for regular symbols. A matching 3×3 symbol wall can open an x3 Wall Multiplier.
Compared with Wild Jack 81, it has one fewer reel, a different line count and a substantially lower stated maximum win of 748x.
wazdan-wild-jack.editorial: The x3 wall enhancement is a local feature rather than the overall ceiling of 748x. Wild-based line-count expansion from version 81 should not be carried over.

features.title: 27 lines on three reels
features.description: Base payouts are distributed across 27 patterns on a compact retro grid.

features.title: Jester Wild
features.description: Substitutes for regular symbols in paying combinations.

features.title: Wall x3 and Gamble
features.description: A 3×3 wall awards an x3 Wall Multiplier, while Gamble operates separately after a win.

intro: Matsuri uses five reels and 25 lines. The Paper Lantern acts as a Wild, while three Festival Masks on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger 8 Free Spins; each additional mask adds two more.

During Free Spins, the Paper Lantern expands across its entire reel and moves one reel left on the next spin until it leaves the grid. Separately, three Goldfish on reels 2–4 trigger a kingyo sukui pick bonus.
playn-go-matsuri.editorial: Matsuri separates two bonuses through different symbols: Festival Masks handle the moving Expanding Wild during Free Spins, while Goldfish open a separate prize choice.

features.title: Festival Mask Free Spins
features.description: Three masks on reels 1, 3 and 5 award eight Free Spins, while each extra mask adds two spins.

features.title: Moving Paper Lantern Wild
features.description: The Wild expands across its whole reel and moves one reel left after every subsequent spin until leaving the grid.

features.title: Kingyo sukui
features.description: Three Goldfish on reels 2, 3 and 4 trigger a separate pick bonus presented as festival goldfish scooping.

intro: Wild Jack 81 expands the original version to four reels and 81 lines. The Joker Wild both substitutes for regular symbols and is tied to expansion of the paying-line count.
This release's technical record shows RTP of 96.73%, a maximum of 2240x and low–medium volatility, while Wild Jack 27 has different figures.
wazdan-wild-jack-81.editorial: This is not a Deluxe presentation: its main differences are four reels, up to 81 lines with Wilds and a separate mathematical profile. The original's x3 wall should not be assigned automatically.

features.title: Four reels
features.description: Version 81 offers a different grid rather than the original's three-reel 27 lines.

features.title: Joker Wild and lines
features.description: The Wild substitutes for regular symbols and increases winning-line count up to 81.

features.title: Gamble after a win
features.description: An awarded payout can be risked separately under the risk-game conditions.

intro: Medusa's Madness uses a 5×5 grid with cascades. Winning symbols disappear, new ones fill the gaps, and the cascade sequence charges the Portal.
Portal Effects include Petrify, clearing rows and columns, and Gaze, removing a selected symbol type. A chain of 42 winning symbols opens Other World Free Round.
playn-go-medusas-madness.editorial: Medusa's Madness' main resource is Portal charge. Cascades do more than produce repeat wins: they gradually open a set of effects and lead to a separate Other World round.

features.title: 5×5 cascades
features.description: After a win, symbols are removed and empty positions fill with new ones; the chain continues while new combinations form.

features.title: Portal Effects
features.description: Petrify clears rows and columns, Gaze removes a selected symbol type, and other effects change the grid under their own rules.

features.title: Other World Free Round
features.description: After 42 winning symbols, a separate round opens with three random Portal Effects; extra charge can add new effects.

intro: Win & Replay on three reels and five lines locks a winning line and awards a free re-spin. The Wild participates in the combination to help retain the paid line.
A separate 3×3 grid fill can activate an x2 Wall Multiplier. Replay specifically means a free repeat after a win here rather than ten empty spins as in Vegas Reels II.
wazdan-win-replay.editorial: RTP of 96.99% is an officially high figure within this group of twenty, but promises neither profit nor a result for an individual session. The whole game's maximum is 500x.

features.title: Locked winning line
features.description: After a win, the line stays held while a free additional spin takes place.

features.title: Replay without another bet
features.description: A special Respin follows a win and provides another chance of a combination.

features.title: x2 Wall Multiplier
features.description: A qualifying nine-symbol fill doubles the payout; Gamble is separate from the base cycle.

intro: Mega Don centres on symbol transformation and gradually increasing symbol value. Three Scatters trigger Free Spins while opening symbol upgrades.
More Scatters on entry award more starting Free Spins and upgrades. New Scatters during the bonus retrigger and continue the symbol-transformation chain.
playn-go-mega-don.editorial: Original Mega Don's central idea is neither choosing among three sharks as in Feeding Frenzy nor three separate Feasts as in Triple Threat. Everything centres on Scatter-driven symbol-upgrade progression here.

features.title: Three Scatters
features.description: Three Scatters open Free Spins and start the first symbol-upgrade stage.

features.title: More Scatters, more enhancements
features.description: Additional Scatters at the trigger increase Free Spins count and available symbol upgrades.

features.title: Retrigger and transformation
features.description: Scatters during Free Spins extend the bonus and continue transforming symbols, increasing their role in subsequent spins.

intro: Mega Don Triple Threat uses three Scatter colours and separate Hangry Meters for Leopard, Hammerhead and Mega Don. Meters display accumulation but do not promise the corresponding Feast on the next spin.

Each shark has its own eight-spin or six-spin scenario: Leopard creates Wilds after eating fish, Hammerhead turns Electric Eel Wilds into multiplier Wilds, and Mega Don gradually activates extra fish types.
playn-go-mega-don-triple-threat.editorial: Triple Threat literally describes its mechanic: multiple Feasts can trigger simultaneously. If Mega Don is among them, its branch retains retriggers, whereas separate Leopard and Hammerhead Feasts do not extend.

features.title: Hangry Meters
features.description: Three coloured Scatters feed three shark meters and display each branch's progress without changing the stated next-trigger probability.

features.title: Leopard and Hammerhead Feast
features.description: Leopard turns eaten fish into Wilds, while Hammerhead enhances Electric Eel Wilds with x2 multipliers that add together in one win.

features.title: Mega Don Feast
features.description: Mega Don starts with one active fish type; three blue Scatters add three spins and open a new type, up to six and 30 Free Spins.

intro: Mega Don: Feeding Frenzy runs on a 5×4 grid. In the base game, random Snack Time selects one to three regular symbols, turns them into high-paying shark symbols and then expands the selected symbol.
Three or more Scatters trigger Shark Feast. The player chooses Leopard, Hammerhead or Mega Don and receives 10, 8 or 6 Free Spins respectively; the selected shark becomes a stacked symbol.
playn-go-mega-don-feeding-frenzy.editorial: Feeding Frenzy differs from original Mega Don through a pre-bonus shark choice. A stronger predator under the feature structure means fewer starting Free Spins, while retriggers are capped at an overall sequence of 20.

features.title: Snack Time
features.description: A random base feature selects 1–3 regular symbols, turns them into a higher-paying shark symbol and expands the selected type.

features.title: Shark Feast
features.description: Leopard awards 10 Free Spins, Hammerhead 8 and Mega Don 6; the selected shark becomes a stacked symbol throughout the sequence.

features.title: Retrigger up to 20 spins
features.description: New Scatters can extend Shark Feast, but the overall bonus length is capped at twenty Free Spins.

intro: Merlin and the Ice Queen Morgana uses a 5×3 grid and Expanding Symbols. Before Free Spins, one regular symbol is selected as the Special Expanding Symbol and remains so for the entire sequence.
Merlin's Staff acts as a Scatter Wild, while Morgana Special Wild can appear singly, doubled or as a full stack on one reel. A full stack activates a separate multiplier.
playn-go-merlin-and-the-ice-queen-morgan.editorial: The two characters have different functions: Merlin is tied to Scatter Wilds and bonus entry, while Morgana handles a special Wild and multiplier. Their effects should not be described as one general expanding Wild.

features.title: Special Expanding Symbol
features.description: One regular symbol is selected before the bonus; if enough are present for a win, it expands across its whole reel even without a complete sequence of neighbouring positions.

features.title: Merlin's Staff
features.description: Merlin's staff acts as both Scatter and Wild, connecting Free Spins entry with substitution for regular symbols.

features.title: Morgana Special Wild
features.description: Morgana appears on one reel in a size of 1, 2 or a full stack; a full stack activates a multiplier for the corresponding event.

intro: Merlin Realm of Charm runs on a 5×3 grid and connects free spins with instant prizes and a selected expanding symbol. When the bonus triggers, a random symbol gains special status and can subsequently cover a whole reel.
After a regular win, a separate card risk game is available: the next card's colour or suit can be predicted in an attempt to increase the current prize.
playn-go-merlin-realm-of-charm.editorial: This Merlin instalment has two independent branches: the card risk game operates after regular wins, while the expanding symbol belongs specifically to free spins.

features.title: Special expanding symbol
features.description: Before free spins, one symbol is selected randomly, can expand across a whole reel and retains its role throughout the bonus sequence.

features.title: Instant prizes at the trigger
features.description: Three or more Scatters trigger free spins and can simultaneously assign separate instant multipliers.

features.title: Card risk game
features.description: After a win, a hidden card's colour or suit can be predicted; an incorrect choice resets the amount entered into the risk round to zero.

intro: Merlin: Journey of Flame builds its bonus around a selected expanding symbol. Before free spins, one regular symbol gains special status and can reveal across a whole reel in a qualifying combination.
Three or more cracked dragon eggs trigger up to eight free spins and add a sixth reel, so the bonus changes the playing grid itself as well as its feature set.
playn-go-merlin-journey-of-flame.editorial: Journey of Flame should not be mixed with other Merlin games: the dragon egg connects to both Wild/Scatter logic here, while the expanding symbol works alongside an additional sixth reel.

features.title: Expanding symbol
features.description: One regular symbol is selected before the bonus; enough matches make it expand across the corresponding whole reel.

features.title: Sixth reel during the bonus
features.description: Three or more Scatters trigger free spins in which an additional sixth reel expands the playing area.

features.title: Merlin risk game
features.description: A win below a specified limit can enter a card mini-game for an attempt to double it through a correct card-colour prediction.

intro: Merlin's Grimoire begins with three active reels, while its central mechanic divides large symbols into smaller pieces. Splitting changes the available position count and creates additional ways to form a combination.
During free spins, the playing area can gradually expand from the starting three to all five reels, raising the ways-to-win count to 7776.
playn-go-merlins-grimoire.editorial: Merlin's Grimoire's main distinction is gradual grid unlocking. Free spins are valuable here for changing combination geometry as the area expands rather than a separate multiplier.

features.title: Symbol splitting
features.description: Large symbols can split into smaller elements, increasing occupied positions and combination possibilities.

features.title: Grid expansion
features.description: The bonus starts on a limited area but can open all five reels as the sequence develops.

features.title: Up to 7776 ways
features.description: Fully unlocking the reels increases available ways to win up to 7776.

intro: Mermaid's Diamond uses 720 ways to win: matches can start from either the left or right edge. The mermaid acts as a Wild and expands across a whole reel when two or more appear on it.
Five chests trigger free spins, while Poseidon can intervene in both the base game and bonus, adding a missing chest or creating extra Wilds.
playn-go-mermaids-diamond.editorial: Poseidon's two roles should be separated: before the bonus, he can help provide a fifth chest, while five diamonds during free spins trigger a separate extra-Wild feature.

features.title: Expanding mermaid Wild
features.description: If at least two mermaids appear on one reel, the Wild expands across the whole reel and participates in combinations in both directions.

features.title: Five chests
features.description: Five Treasure Chests trigger free spins; the selected chest determines their starting count, up to 25.

features.title: Poseidon's help
features.description: Four chests can receive a fifth through random intervention, while five diamonds during the bonus trigger special trident Wilds.

intro: Merry Xmas is a classic 15-line slot in which a Wild on the middle reel can enhance a win up to x5. Three Santas on the first three reels award 10 free spins.
Every free spin adds two new Wilds to reels 2–5. They extend existing stacks, gradually making the grid more densely filled with Wilds.
playn-go-merry-xmas.editorial: Merry Xmas' bonus centres on Wild accumulation rather than random mode changes: every new pair expands stacks, while a retrigger can increase the sequence to 20 spins.

features.title: Wild up to x5
features.description: A gift Wild appears on the middle reel, substitutes for regular symbols and can multiply the qualifying payout up to x5.

features.title: Growing Wild stacks
features.description: Every free spin adds two new Wilds to reels 2–5, lengthening stacks already accumulated.

features.title: Gift bonus
features.description: Three gift symbols trigger a separate award choice unrelated to the Santa free-spin trigger.

intro: Midnight Gold builds its base game around a delivery symbol on the fifth reel. Its appearance collects all visible money symbols: bags carry multipliers, while a chest on the first reel can contain a notably larger value.
Three Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 open a choice between two free-spin modes: stacked Wilds or moving Wilds. A golden Scatter on the fifth reel upgrades the trigger to an enhanced version.
playn-go-midnight-gold.editorial: Midnight Gold has three distinct layers: delivery-based money-value collection, Wild-type selection in regular free spins, and an enhanced bonus guaranteeing a Wild multiplier on every turn.

features.title: Money-symbol collection
features.description: The delivery symbol appears only on the fifth reel and collects all money-symbol values visible in the current round.

features.title: Two free-spin modes
features.description: The choice is between three-position Wild stacks or moving Wilds retained for the next turn and changing position.

features.title: Enhanced free spins
features.description: A special golden Scatter on the fifth reel triggers a mode guaranteeing a Wild multiplier on every spin.

intro: Miner Donkey Trouble uses a 5×7 grid with clusters and cascades. Winning symbols disappear, new ones fall from above, and winning-group sizes gradually charge a queue of destructive donkey features.
Gold nuggets do not form wins themselves. A nugget reaching the bottom row is removed and increases the overall multiplier by +1; this progress carries into free spins as well.
playn-go-miner-donkey-trouble.editorial: Cascades serve two purposes here: creating new clusters and filling destruction thresholds. The strongest feature version clears almost the entire grid, leaving nuggets and adding new ones.

features.title: Three destruction levels
features.description: Thresholds of 18, 40 and 50 winning symbols queue increasingly strong grid clears.

features.title: Nuggets and multiplier
features.description: A gold nugget reaching the bottom row is removed and raises the overall multiplier by one step.

features.title: Cascade feature queue
features.description: Accumulated destruction effects run after current wins finish, then the grid is checked again for new clusters.

intro: Mirror Joker starts on a compact 3×3 grid with five fixed lines. Two matching symbol stacks trigger a mirror respin and expand the grid to 5×3.
During the respin, original stacks mirror onto the new reels, while active lines double to ten. The special Joker Wild in this mode pays combinations both left to right and right to left.
playn-go-mirror-joker.editorial: Mirror Respin changes geometry, line count and Wild-combination direction simultaneously. It is therefore different from a regular repeat spin on the same grid.

features.title: Mirror respin
features.description: Two matching stacks expand the grid from 3×3 to 5×3 and mirror onto the added reels.

features.title: Ten lines
features.description: After expansion, active lines increase from five to ten for the special respin.

features.title: Two-way Joker Wild
features.description: In mirror mode, the special Wild substitutes for regular symbols and can participate in payouts in both directions.

intro: Mission Cash uses five reels and 20 lines, with a moving crosshair as its central random mechanic. It stops on one symbol and, depending on the target, either activates a feature or ends the chain.

If the crosshair hits a red or blue agent, the character expands across the entire reel, that reel locks, and remaining positions receive a respin. A Scatter under the crosshair moves into 8 free spins.
playn-go-mission-cash.editorial: Mission Cash's main risk lies in crosshair movement: red and blue agents continue the locked-Wild chain, while hitting other agents or a low-paying symbol stops it.

features.title: Moving crosshair
features.description: The crosshair moves across the reels and, on stopping, determines which feature activates in the current round.

features.title: Expanding agents
features.description: A red or blue agent under the crosshair fills its reel and locks, while other reels receive another respin.

features.title: Eight free spins
features.description: A Scatter under the crosshair triggers eight spins; all agents can become expanding Wilds within the bonus.

intro: Monkey: Battle for the Scrolls uses four characters above the reels. Their icons change positions, and a Demon Scatter beneath a particular character triggers that character's feature; multiple Scatters activate effects sequentially.
Three closed scrolls trigger free spins. One of four heroes is selected before the sequence, setting spin count and multiplier, while an open scroll beneath a hero additionally enhances its feature.
playn-go-monkey-battle-for-the-scrolls.editorial: The characters are more than different animations of one bonus. The selected hero determines a distinct free-spin profile, while base-game Demon Scatters invoke whoever stands directly above the reel.

features.title: Four character features
features.description: Hero icons move above the reels; a Demon Scatter beneath an icon triggers that character's individual ability.

features.title: Hero selection in the bonus
features.description: Three closed scrolls open free spins, before which a hero is selected with its own turn count and multiplier.

features.title: Two progressive jackpots
features.description: The middle three reels can light up: two jackpot symbols award Minor, while three award Major.

intro: The original Moon Princess runs on a 5×5 grid: three or more matching symbols connect vertically or horizontally, disappear, and new ones fall from above. Every new cascade increases the current round's multiplier.

Love, Star and Storm have different abilities: Love transforms a symbol type, Star adds a Wild, and Storm removes symbols. A fully charged Trinity meter triggers a respin in which all three princess abilities activate in sequence.
playn-go-moon-princess.editorial: The original establishes the series' foundation: Girl Power randomly rescues non-winning rounds, Trinity combines three abilities, and clearing all 25 cells moves the game into a separate free-spin mode.

features.title: Three princesses' Girl Power
features.description: Love transforms symbols, Star adds a Wild, and Storm removes symbol sets, creating new cluster opportunities.

features.title: Trinity meter
features.description: Wins with princesses charge the meter; once full, all three abilities run sequentially within one special respin.

features.title: Grid clearing and free spins
features.description: Removing all 25 symbols triggers free spins with a growing multiplier; the sequence can extend up to 20 turns.

intro: Moon Princess 100 retains the familiar Girl Power grid but raises the bonus ceilings. Both the multiplier and maximum free-spin count can reach 100.
A full grid clear awards a fixed x50 the bet. Free spins trigger after clearing the grid in Trinity mode, and a princess is chosen before the sequence whose ability activates on non-winning turns.
playn-go-moon-princess-100.editorial: Version 100 differs from the original mainly in progression scale: Love, Star and Storm's base logic remains familiar, but the upper multiplier and bonus-duration limits rise to 100.

features.title: Multiplier up to x100
features.description: Cascade sequences and bonus progression can raise the multiplier far beyond the original version, up to x100.

features.title: Up to 100 free spins
features.description: The bonus can extend, with the overall free-spin count capped at one hundred.

features.title: Full-clear prize
features.description: Removing every symbol from the grid awards a separate x50 the total bet.

intro: Moon Princess Extreme returns to a 5×5 grid and connections from three matching symbols. After every win, symbols are removed, new ones fall into the gaps, and the multiplier grows with every new cascade.

Love, Star and Storm again use different powers: Love transforms one symbol set into another, Star adds a Wild, and Storm removes two sets at once. Removing a minimum group of three can create an extra Wild.
playn-go-moon-princess-extreme.editorial: Extreme makes the core cascade cycle more aggressive: Wilds can appear immediately after a short winning group, while the multiplier rises on every new drop without waiting for a separate bonus.

features.title: Cascades with a growing multiplier
features.description: After every win, the grid refills and the current-chain multiplier increases on every subsequent drop.

features.title: Wilds from short combinations
features.description: Removing a three-symbol winning group can create a Wild on the grid, helping continue the chain.

features.title: Three princess powers
features.description: Love transforms a symbol set, Star adds a Wild, and Storm removes two symbol types from the current grid.

intro: Moon Princess Origins uses a 5×5 cascading grid but adds persistent enhanced princess states. A combination of five or more regular symbols can enhance their associated princess until the next use of her ability.

Love transforms several sets at once, enhanced Star adds more Wilds, and enhanced Storm clears more symbols. If all three princesses participate in wins during one round, the Trinity meter charges and triggers three powers in sequence.
playn-go-moon-princess-origins.editorial: Origins differs from the original because a princess enhancement can persist between spins. This creates accumulated progression until the corresponding Girl Power finally activates.

features.title: Enhancing princesses
features.description: Five or more matching regular symbols place the associated princess in an enhanced state lasting until her ability activates.

features.title: Recharged Trinity
features.description: Wins with all three princesses charge the meter; when full, Love, Storm and Star activate sequentially.

features.title: Free-spin orbs
features.description: A complete clear triggers 10 spins; another bonus clear can award an instant orb with a confirmed range from 5x to 10000x the bet.

intro: Moon Princess Power of Love uses a 5×5 grid and a separate love meter. Clearing symbols fills it, after which Love, Prince Hail or Prince Blaze activates a power.
Love transforms a symbol type, Hail synchronises two columns, and Blaze adds several matching symbols to the grid. A full clear awards x50 the bet and triggers free spins.
playn-go-moon-princess-power-of-love.editorial: Power of Love replaces the original's familiar trio with a love triangle. One of two princes is selected before the bonus, and his ability then activates on every non-winning spin.

features.title: Love meter
features.description: Removed symbols fill the meter, after which one of three abilities changes the current grid.

features.title: Ice or fire
features.description: Prince Hail links two columns with identical contents, while Prince Blaze adds two to four matching symbols to the grid.

features.title: Up to 100 free spins
features.description: Clearing the whole grid triggers the bonus and awards x50 the bet; repeated clears can add three spins at a time up to the overall limit of 100.

intro: Moon Princess Stargazing uses a 5×5 grid and highlights three to ten positions. A win passing through a highlighted cell increases the multiplier by +1, up to x100.
Star adds a Wild, Nova draws a diagonal Wild chain, and Astra creates a Sticky Wild. Princess matches charge Resonance, where all three powers run sequentially.
playn-go-moon-princess-stargazing.editorial: Stargazing goes beyond Girl Power: highlighted cells form a separate constellation system. Filling every marked position in one round opens an instant Constellation Prize.

features.title: Multiplier through highlighted cells
features.description: A win through marked positions raises the multiplier by one step, up to x100.

features.title: Three new abilities
features.description: Star adds random Wilds, Nova creates a Wild diagonal, and Astra locks a Sticky Wild for several connections.

features.title: Resonance and constellations
features.description: A full meter triggers all three powers in order; fully activating highlighted cells opens a separate instant prize.

intro: Moon Princess Trinity again uses a dynamic grid: groups of three or more symbols disappear, while the multiplier begins at x1. A full grid clear awards x50 the bet and raises the multiplier by +1 for the next level.
Girl Power can activate after winning combinations. Love transforms symbols, Star places one or two Wilds, and Storm removes low-paying symbols and replaces them with higher-paying symbols or Wilds.
playn-go-moon-princess-trinity.editorial: Trinity becomes a separate cyclic target here: high-paying wins fill the meter, then all three princesses activate within one free round, while a full clear repeats that round without resetting the multiplier.

features.title: Five multiplier stages
features.description: A full clear raises the multiplier by +1, forming several successive progression levels.

features.title: Girl Power on wins
features.description: Love, Star and Storm intervene randomly after successful combinations and change the grid differently.

features.title: Trinity cycle
features.description: A full meter awards one special round with all three powers; clearing its grid repeats the round without resetting the multiplier.

intro: Moon Princess: Christmas Kingdom brings Love, Star and Storm onto a festive 5×5 grid while retaining the cascade foundation. Girl Power activates randomly after a non-winning starting spin.
Love turns one symbol type into another, Star adds one or two Wilds, and Storm removes two symbol types. A complete grid clear awards x50 the bet plus the current round's accumulated multiplier.
playn-go-moon-princess-christmas-kingdom.editorial: Christmas Kingdom is closest to the original's classic formula but remains a separate version with festive presentation and its own Clear Grid Prize. Later Origins or Stargazing mechanics should not be carried over.

features.title: Festive Girl Power
features.description: On a non-winning starting spin, one of three princesses can change the grid with her signature ability.

features.title: 5×5 cascade grid
features.description: Winning groups are removed, new symbols take free positions and can continue the current round.

features.title: Grid-clear prize
features.description: Removing every symbol from the grid awards x50 the total bet plus the multiplier accumulated in the current round.

intro: Mötley Crüe uses several musical base-game features. Wild stacks can appear on the fifth reel and move backwards across the grid until a win forms.
A separate random feature adds Wilds to the reels, while three Pentagram Scatters trigger the bonus: pentagram numbers determine the free-spin count.
playn-go-motley-crue.editorial: The musical names correspond to different mechanics rather than one general Wild bonus: one moves stacks, another adds random Wilds, and a third determines Free Spins duration.

features.title: Moving Wild stacks
features.description: A Wild stack appears on the right and moves backwards across the reels until helping form a winning combination.

features.title: Random extra Wilds
features.description: A separate base feature can place new Wilds across the reels without a preceding trigger.

features.title: Pentagram and free spins
features.description: Three Scatters open a numbered pentagram; matching values determine bonus-sequence duration.

intro: Mount M builds its bonus around climbing expanding centre reels. Three Scatters trigger free spins, where Wilds add orbs into an ice block.
Five collected orbs break the ice and increase centre-reel height. At the same time, high-paying animals become Mammoth symbols, while the sequence receives an extra free spin.
playn-go-mount-m.editorial: Mount M's grid expansion is an accumulation target throughout the sequence: after every full set of five orbs, the centre reels grow taller and the cycle restarts, up to eight symbols high.

features.title: Five orbs for expansion
features.description: Wilds fill the ice block with orbs; after the fifth orb, the ice breaks and the centre reels grow.

features.title: Evolution into mammoths
features.description: Each expansion transforms high-paying symbols into Mammoth symbols, changing future combinations.

features.title: Respin on glowing reels
features.description: A Wild on highlighted centre reels can trigger a respin and open several expansions and symbol upgrades at once.

intro: Muerto en Mictlán builds its underworld journey as a sequence of levels, each associated with its own Wild-symbol feature. Catrin and Catrina guide transitions between stages during play.
The key distinction is choosing the onward route through different Wild variants, including expanding, sticky, walking and exploding versions.
playn-go-muerto-en-mictlan.editorial: Muerto en Mictlán is a slot with a route through levels rather than a collection of random Wild events: feature choice determines the next section of the Mictlán journey.

features.title: Different Wild-symbol types
features.description: Separate stages correspond to different effects: expansion, locking, reel movement or destruction of neighbouring positions.

features.title: Choosing a route
features.description: Mictlán progression offers a choice of the next Wild feature, changing the character of the following level.

features.title: Five reels
features.description: The base game retains a regular five-reel structure, with most variety coming from changing levels and Wild mechanics.

intro: Multifruit 81 is a fruit slot with 81 ways to win. The Joker substitutes for regular symbols, while several Jokers in one combination increase the multiplier.
Every spin highlights one random reel. If a Joker lands there, it expands across all three reel positions and creates extra combination possibilities.
playn-go-multifruit-81.editorial: There is no long bonus chain here: all the game's specificity lies in the Joker. Its strength depends both on Wild count and landing on the highlighted reel.

features.title: 81 ways to win
features.description: Combinations form through a ways system rather than a set of fixed lines.

features.title: Joker multipliers
features.description: Two Jokers award an x2 multiplier, three award x5, and four Jokers are tied to a payout up to x1000 the total bet.

features.title: Expansion on a highlighted reel
features.description: One reel lights up before every spin; a Joker there expands across its full three-position height.

intro: Mystery Egg Surprise uses three reels and five fixed lines. Three Scatter baskets trigger 10 free spins in which mystery eggs take the central role.
Two mystery eggs reveal a random prize multiplier up to x100 the total bet. Three eggs award an instant prize while extending free spins.
playn-go-mystery-egg-surprise.editorial: This is deliberately a simple slot: its base game is almost classic, while all variation moves into free spins through two Mystery Egg thresholds—two and three symbols.

features.title: 10 free spins
features.description: Three Scatter baskets trigger a bonus sequence that can subsequently extend repeatedly.

features.title: Multiplier for two eggs
features.description: Two Mystery Eggs during the bonus reveal a random multiplier that can reach x100 the total bet.

features.title: Prize and retrigger
features.description: Three Mystery Eggs award an instant prize and add new free spins; total added spins can reach 50.

intro: Mystery Genie Fortunes of the Lamp runs on a 5×4 grid. Mystery symbols reveal matching regular symbols, special symbols or Wild symbols with multipliers.
Sand Rewind conceals Mystery Symbols again, locks them together with Scatters and Mystery Wilds, then triggers a re-spin. Three Scatters open eight free spins.
playn-go-mystery-genie-fortunes-of-the-l.editorial: Mystery Genie's main distinction is reusing mystery symbols already landed. Sand Rewind does more than award a new spin: it holds valuable positions before another reveal.

features.title: Mystery symbols
features.description: After a genie appears, Mystery Symbols reveal and synchronise regular winning symbols or become special elements.

features.title: Wild multipliers x2–x5
features.description: Mystery Wilds can carry an x2 to x5 multiplier and enhance combinations in which they participate.

features.title: Sand respin
features.description: Sand Rewind conceals mystery symbols again, locks Mystery Symbols, Scatters and Mystery Wilds, and triggers a re-spin.

intro: Mystery Joker is an early three-reel slot with a very simple structure. The Joker hat acts as a Scatter, and three trigger free spins.
During free spins, a mystery prize remains possible. Two or three Scatters within the sequence add new spins.
playn-go-mystery-joker.editorial: Original Mystery Joker is notably simpler than version 6000: it has no Super Meter or wheel. Its main bonus mechanic is free spins with retriggers and a mystery prize.

features.title: Three reels
features.description: The compact classic structure makes spin results easy to read without extra grids or cascades.

features.title: Hat Scatter
features.description: Three Joker hats trigger free spins, while two or three hats in the bonus add new spins.

features.title: Mystery prize
features.description: A separate mystery award can activate during the free-spin sequence.

intro: Mystery Joker 6000 retains the classic 3×3 grid but adds a separate Super Meter. Three matching symbols form a regular payout, while two Jokers can award a free respin to try completing a line.
Wins can be transferred into the Super Meter and then used for play in an enhanced mode. Three Joker hats trigger the Mystery Wheel with a potential award up to 6000x the current bet.
playn-go-mystery-joker-6000.editorial: Version 6000 is not a cosmetic remaster of the original: its central system is a separate accumulating Super Meter and wheel, whereas simple Mystery Joker centred on free spins.

features.title: Free respin
features.description: Two Jokers can trigger an additional spin, offering a chance to obtain the third symbol and complete the combination.

features.title: Super Meter
features.description: Part of the winnings can be transferred into a separate counter and the accumulated funds used to play in enhanced mode.

features.title: Mystery Wheel
features.description: Three Joker hats trigger a wheel whose maximum stated award reaches 6000x the current bet.

intro: Myth centres on Wild-enhanced payouts. A regular winning combination containing a Wild pays double.
Three or more Scatters trigger free spins in which regular wins triple. If a Wild participates in such a combination, the final payout reaches six times its regular value.
playn-go-myth.editorial: Myth is an example of Play’n GO's older line-based logic: the bonus does not rebuild the grid but successively increases multipliers on familiar combinations.

features.title: Wild doubles a win
features.description: A base-game combination containing a Wild symbol pays twice its regular value.

features.title: Triple free-spin payouts
features.description: Standard winning combinations receive an x3 multiplier during the bonus sequence.

features.title: Up to 60 free spins
features.description: The bonus can retrigger, gradually increasing total sequence duration to its specified 60-spin limit.

intro: Myth of Dead uses a 5×3 grid with 10 lines. Three or more Scatters trigger free spins and randomly select one of four divine boosters.
Every collected Wild advances the player along the Coronation Path. Path checkpoints award additional free spins and raise the instant-prize multiplier up to x5.
playn-go-myth-of-dead.editorial: Myth of Dead differs from classic Dead slots through Coronation Path progression. Its Wild both helps combinations and supplies progress through twelve coronations.

features.title: Four bonus boosters
features.description: Before free spins, one effect is selected randomly: more frequent God Symbols, more Wilds, +1 to the instant-prize multiplier or three extra spins.

features.title: Random Wild respin
features.description: A re-spin can activate in the base game, allowing instant prizes attached to God Symbols to collect.

features.title: Coronation Path
features.description: Collected Wilds advance along a twelve-stage path, opening extra spins and Instant Prize enhancements.

intro: Naughty Nick's Book uses a book Scatter as bonus entry. Three or more books open an additional sixth reel and trigger eight free spins.
Before the sequence, a random regular symbol is selected as the special expanding symbol. Three new Scatters retrigger the bonus and add another eight spins.
playn-go-naughty-nicks-book.editorial: This Christmas version of the book formula makes its main change visible immediately at bonus entry: the grid physically gains a sixth reel, and the expanding symbol operates on that expanded configuration.

features.title: Additional sixth reel
features.description: When free spins trigger, another reel opens on the right and remains throughout the bonus sequence.

features.title: Special expanding symbol
features.description: One regular symbol is selected randomly before the bonus and can expand across a whole reel when enough matches are present.

features.title: Card risk round
features.description: After a win below a specified limit, an attempt can be made to double the amount through card colour or quadruple it through suit.

intro: New Year Riches triggers 10 free spins through three midnight-clock symbols. The bonus starts immediately with an x2 multiplier.
After each subsequent free spin, the multiplier increases by another x2, gradually reaching x20. A champagne bottle acts as the Wild symbol.
playn-go-new-year-riches.editorial: The bonus has a completely predictable pace: its multiplier grows step by step with spin number. Later turns therefore differ mathematically from early turns without additional random modifiers.

features.title: 10 free spins
features.description: Three clock Scatters trigger a fixed starting sequence of ten spins.

features.title: Growing multiplier
features.description: The first bonus spin uses x2, then the value increases by another x2 on every subsequent turn up to x20.

features.title: Champagne Wild
features.description: The champagne bottle substitutes for regular symbols and helps form winning combinations.

intro: Ninja Fruits divides its bonuses between two special-symbol sets. Shurikens on reels 3–5 trigger a mini-game involving fruit hits and coin collection.
Geishas on reels 1, 3 and 5 award a payout and trigger free spins. Before the sequence, one regular symbol randomly becomes an additional Scatter.
playn-go-ninja-fruits.editorial: The shuriken and geisha handle entirely different branches. Hit-the-Fruits is a separate precision mini-game, while Free Spins changes one regular symbol's role through an Extra Scatter.

features.title: Shuriken mini-game
features.description: Three shurikens trigger throws at fruit: every hit awards coins, while a miss ends the bonus.

features.title: Additional Scatter
features.description: Before free spins, one regular symbol is selected randomly as the Extra Scatter and operates throughout the sequence.

features.title: Card risk round
features.description: A regular win can be doubled through a card-colour prediction or quadrupled through a correct suit choice.

intro: Nugget n’ Nonsense builds its game around coins. Six coins directly trigger a hold-and-respin mode, where landed Coins lock and every new hit resets the counter to three.
Coins can also randomly activate the Bonus Wheel. The wheel awards instant prizes, regular bonus spins or an enhanced Super Bonus Spins sequence.
playn-go-nugget-n-nonsense.editorial: The same Coin supplies several systems here: direct Hold & Spin, a random wheel and reel-multiplier development on reels 2 and 4 during bonus spins.

features.title: Hold and respins
features.description: Six Coins trigger a mode with three attempts; new coins stay on the grid and completely replenish the counter.

features.title: Bonus wheel
features.description: Base-game coins can activate a wheel with instant prize tiers, Bonus Spins or Super Bonus Spins.

features.title: Growing multipliers
features.description: During bonus sequences, multipliers attach to reels 2 and 4 and can increase after wins, reaching up to x20 in the enhanced mode.

intro: Oasis of Dead uses a 5×3 grid and 20 lines. Up to five Scatters trigger free spins while assigning a starting multiplier and selecting a special expanding symbol.
A low-paying special symbol needs to appear on three reels to expand, while a high-paying one needs two. Three or more new Scatters add another eight spins and another expanding symbol.
playn-go-oasis-of-dead.editorial: Unlimited Free Spins refers to the lack of a fixed retrigger count here: three Scatters again add eight turns and a new expanding symbol, so the special-symbol set can grow during the sequence.

features.title: Special expanding symbol
features.description: A random symbol is selected before free spins; high-paying symbols need two reels to expand, while low-paying ones require three.

features.title: Retriggers without a fixed limit
features.description: Three or more Scatters during the bonus add another eight spins and assign an additional expanding symbol.

features.title: Card risk game
features.description: A regular win can be doubled through card colour or quadrupled through correct suit, with up to five consecutive attempts.

intro: Octopus Treasure connects a key on the third reel with a treasure chest. An opened chest triggers one of four underwater features: turning symbols Wild, collecting an instant prize, Wild reels or symbol transformation for new lines.
Three Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger Key Re-Spins with three starting spins. Every new key adds another, and Treasure Spins begins after the sequence.
playn-go-octopus-treasure.editorial: Octopus Treasure's bonus has two stages: Key Re-Spins first accumulates keys, then Treasure Spins guarantees a bonus feature on every spin. This is not one regular Free Spins round.

features.title: Four chest features
features.description: A key on the third reel opens the chest and randomly selects Wild Coins, Treasure Grab, Wild Reels or Gold Pile.

features.title: Key Re-Spins
features.description: Three special Scatters trigger three starting spins, while each new key adds another attempt.

features.title: Treasure Spins
features.description: After Key Re-Spins, a sequence starts in which every turn includes a Bonus Feature and keys continue adding spins.

intro: Odin Protector of Realms uses a hexagonal grid of 37 positions. Five or more matching symbols connected along their sides form a cluster, after which winning elements disappear and start a cascade.
Every removed winning symbol simultaneously charges the Ring Charge Metre. At 30, 70 and 120 symbols, bronze, silver and gold features are added to the queue.
playn-go-odin-protector-of-realms.editorial: Odin's meter depends on winning symbols rather than time or spin count. Large cascade sequences therefore unlock subsequent Forged-feature levels faster.

features.title: Hexagonal grid
features.description: The grid has 37 positions, with clusters formed from five or more connected matching symbols.

features.title: Cascades
features.description: Winning clusters are removed, free positions fill with new symbols, and the grid is checked again for combinations.

features.title: Three charge levels
features.description: After 30, 70 and 120 collected winning symbols, increasingly strong Forged features enter the queue.

intro: Pack & Cash uses five reels and 1024 ways to win, with symbols arriving right to left. After a win, the combination is removed, new symbols cascade into gaps, and the current spin's multiplier increases by +1.
Express Packages appear in groups of three to eight and reveal one matching symbol. At a non-winning stage, Special Delivery can activate randomly and guarantee a new winning combination.
playn-go-pack-and-cash.editorial: Pack & Cash's distinction is right-to-left cascades and two rescue mechanisms: mystery packages reveal in sync, while Special Delivery intervenes only when the current chain has not produced a win.

features.title: 1024 ways and cascades
features.description: Winning symbols are removed, new ones fill gaps right to left, and the multiplier grows with every successful cascade.

features.title: Express Packages
features.description: Three to eight mystery packages reveal simultaneously and turn into one random regular symbol or Wild, but not Scatter.

features.title: Special Delivery
features.description: On a non-winning initial turn or after a cascade, a random feature changes the grid to guarantee a new combination.

intro: Pandastic Adventure uses a 5×3 grid and builds progression around a temple journey. During Temple Free Spins, collected Wilds both enhance instant prizes and advance towards the next stage.
After free spins finish, a Bonus Round opens. Collecting eight Wilds there triggers a hold-and-respin mode with regular awards and four prize tiers.
playn-go-pandastic-adventure.editorial: Free spins are the first stage rather than the finale here. Their purpose is Wild accumulation and preparation for Temple Treasure Bonus, where a separate Hold & Spin activates.

features.title: Path to the temple
features.description: Collected Wilds during free spins increase instant prizes and advance progress towards Temple Treasure Bonus.

features.title: Second bonus stage
features.description: After Temple Free Spins, the game can move into a separate Bonus Round with its own Wild-collection system.

features.title: Hold and respins
features.description: Eight collected Wilds trigger Hold & Spin with regular payouts and Mini, Minor, Major and Grand tiers.

intro: Pandora's Box of Evil uses the Mystery Symbol as its central object. If Zeus' lightning strikes a closed box, it becomes a Mystery Wild with an x2–x5 multiplier instead of a regular reveal.
If the Spirit of Hope is inside, Re-Spin of Hope triggers: mystery symbols close again, then Mystery Symbols, Scatters and Mystery Wilds lock before a re-spin.
playn-go-pandoras-box-of-evil.editorial: Pandora's Box effects depend on intervention timing: a regular opening awards a symbol, Zeus striking before opening creates a multiplier Wild, and Spirit of Hope moves special positions already collected into a locked respin.

features.title: Mystery box
features.description: A Mystery Symbol reveals one of the possible symbols, providing the underlying uncertainty whenever a box appears.

features.title: Zeus' lightning
features.description: A strike before opening turns the box into a Mystery Wild with a multiplier from x2 to x5.

features.title: Re-Spin of Hope
features.description: Spirit of Hope closes mystery symbols again, locks them alongside Scatters and Mystery Wilds, and triggers an additional spin.

intro: Pearl Lagoon uses a classic multiplier model: a base-game win with a Wild pays double, while three or more Scatters trigger free spins.
During free spins, regular wins triple. A combination containing a Wild pays six times its base value.
playn-go-pearl-lagoon.editorial: Pearl Lagoon almost mirrors Myth's older formula in an ocean theme. There is no modern collector progression here: fixed x3 and x6 values and retriggers define bonus strength.

features.title: Base-game Wild x2
features.description: A winning combination containing a Wild symbol pays double.

features.title: Triple bonus payouts
features.description: Three or more Scatters trigger free spins, where regular winning combinations receive an x3 multiplier.

features.title: Up to 60 free spins
features.description: The sequence can retrigger, gradually bringing the total free-spin count up to 60.

intro: Pearls of India uses two independent Scatters: temples accumulate for a separate bonus game, while three pearls trigger free spins. Rich Wilde substitutes for regular symbols only on the three centre reels.
Collected temples persist separately for the current bet size, even between game sessions. Completing the collection opens a choice of one of three temple trials.
playn-go-pearls-of-india.editorial: The persistent temple counter distinguishes this game: progress does not reset after one session. Pearls handle an entirely different branch—free spins with a growing multiplier up to x50.

features.title: Three temple trials
features.description: After accumulating Temple symbols, the choices are Statue of Vishnu, Wheel of Brahma or Wall of Shiva, each determining a prize differently.

features.title: Pearls during free spins
features.description: Three Pearls trigger the bonus; every five collected pearls add spins and increase the multiplier up to x50.

features.title: Persistent temple collection
features.description: Temple collection progress is tied to bet size, stored between sessions and continued when returning to the same bet.

intro: Perfect Gems uses six vertical reels and an additional horizontal row above the centre of the grid. In Dynamic Payways, a symbol beneath a qualifying upper gem splits, increasing that reel's height up to seven positions.
Every winning cascade removes combinations, fills gaps and raises the multiplier by one step. Three, four, five or six Scatters open Perfect Spins, awarding 9, 15, 21 or 27 spins respectively.
playn-go-perfect-gems.editorial: Perfect Gems differs from Prism of Gems: its multiplier grows through the entire spin's cascades, and Perfect Spins carries the current value into the bonus without resetting it between free spins.

features.title: Dynamic Payways
features.description: A match between an upper-row symbol and the gem beneath splits the lower symbol in two; centre reels can grow to seven symbols.

features.title: Cascade multiplier
features.description: After a winning cascade, symbols are replaced and the overall multiplier rises by +1; outside the bonus, the next spin starts it again.

features.title: Perfect Spins
features.description: Three to six Scatters award 9/15/21/27 spins; every extra Spin Scatter during the bonus adds two more, while the accumulated multiplier persists.

intro: Phoenix Reborn uses five reels with six symbols each and 40 lines. The Phoenix Wild substitutes for regular symbols and expands across the reel's full height after landing.

Three, four or five Aztec Masks trigger 7, 12 or 20 Free Spins. During the bonus, at least one reel on every turn is covered by an expanded Phoenix Wild, while additional Phoenixes can appear on the others.
playn-go-phoenix-reborn.editorial: Phoenix Reborn's main distinction goes beyond having a Wild: one reel is guaranteed to expand during Free Spins. Starting spin count depends on mask count rather than being identical for all triggers.

features.title: Phoenix Wild
features.description: The Wild phoenix substitutes for regular symbols and expands across a reel's full height on landing.

features.title: Aztec Mask Free Spins
features.description: Three masks award seven spins, four twelve and five twenty; new masks can extend an ongoing sequence.

features.title: Guaranteed phoenix
features.description: Every bonus turn contains an expanded Phoenix on one reel; additional Wilds can appear on the others.

intro: Photo Safari is a line slot with up to 20 lines selectable. Its reels contain three distinct special roles: djembe drums act as Wilds, film rolls as Scatters and cameras as a separate Bonus.
Three or more Film Rolls trigger Film Strip Spins, where the film itself becomes Wild. Three Cameras open a standalone Photo Shoot mini-game rather than those same spins.
playn-go-photo-safari.editorial: Photo Safari differs from a regular single-Scatter game: Film Strip Spins and Photo Shoot trigger through different symbols and are not two names for one bonus.

features.title: Up to 20 active lines
features.description: Lines activate sequentially; an African-drum Wild helps form regular combinations.

features.title: Film Strip Spins
features.description: Three film-roll symbols trigger free spins, during which the Film Roll also acts as a substituting Wild.

features.title: Photo Shoot
features.description: Three Cameras trigger a separate photo bonus, distinct from the film-triggered free-spin sequence.

intro: Piggy Bank Farm occupies a 5×4 grid with 50 lines. A Hammer on the fifth reel triggers Piggy Bank Spins with three lives, where piggy banks lock and can merge into large blocks from 2×2 up to the full 5×4 grid.

Scatters on the first, third and fifth reels open eight Free Spins with extensions possible. Hammers during the bonus also trigger Piggy Bank Spins, while multiple hammers can enhance the collected award with a multiplier.
playn-go-piggy-bank-farm.editorial: Piggy Bank Farm does not belong to the Piggy Blitz system. Its Hold mechanic centres on the Hammer and sticky piggy banks merging into megablocks rather than coin collectors and Blitz Spinz.

features.title: Piggy Bank Spins
features.description: Three starting lives, locked piggy banks and larger blocks of 2×2, 3×3, 4×4 or 5×4; an empty turn takes a life.

features.title: Three Scatter positions
features.description: Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 award eight Free Spins; repeating that set within the sequence adds another three.

features.title: Hammer Multipliers
features.description: During Free Spins, multiple hammers can trigger Piggy Bank Spins and multiply its result up to x10 relative to the mode's regular result.

intro: The original Piggy Blitz runs with 4096 ways to win and Cash Collection: coins carry separate values, while a piggy-bank symbol collects them into the current prize.
Three, four, five or six Scatters open 5, 10, 25 or 50 Blitz Spinz. The bonus focuses on guaranteed winning spins and collection of Cash Collection symbols.
playn-go-piggy-blitz.editorial: Original Piggy Blitz has neither Casino Gold's accumulating Bonus Game Multiplier nor Disco Gold's Free Spinz choice. Its foundation is 4096 ways, coin collection and varying Blitz Spinz duration by Scatter count.

features.title: 4096 ways to win
features.description: Combinations and Cash Coin collection operate in parallel: coins can award bet-based multipliers with a Piggy Bank participating.

features.title: Blitz Spinz
features.description: Three, four, five and six Scatters assign 5, 10, 25 and 50 free spins respectively.

features.title: Cash Collection
features.description: Piggy-bank symbols collect coins and values; Blitz Spinz emphasises collectable coins and guaranteed winning turns.

intro: Piggy Blitz Casino Gold centres on six reels and 4096 ways. Pig Collect takes visible money Coins, while two Collects without Coin Scatters can trigger a separate Re-Spin.
The Bonus Game Multiplier is visible in the base game: it starts at x1, rises to x5 and applies only in Blitz Spins or Free Spins. The meter returns to x1 after the bonus ends.
playn-go-piggy-blitz-casino-gold.editorial: Casino Gold differs from Disco Gold specifically through its accumulating Bonus Game Multiplier. The growing piggy bank above the grid is a visual effect rather than a separate prize-probability counter; real bonus multipliers calculate separately.

features.title: Pig Collect and Re-Spin
features.description: The collector takes Coin values; two Collects without Scatters can award an extra spin.

features.title: Bonus Game Multiplier
features.description: The x1–x5 meter grows in the base game after exactly two Scatters or a random increase; it is active during the bonus and resets afterwards.

features.title: Blitz / Free / Mystery Spinz
features.description: Bonus modes differ: Blitz Spins guarantees Pig Collect on every turn, while Free Spins develops a separate level system.
