intro: Piggy Blitz Disco Gold brings coin collection to six reels with Cash Coins worth x0.5 to x25 the bet. A piggy bank on the first or sixth reel collects their values; two simultaneous piggy banks double the collection.
Three to six Scatters offer a choice of Blitz Spinz, Free Spinz and Mystery Spinz. Separately, Gold Piggy can randomly award an instant prize without requiring accumulation from previous turns.
playn-go-piggy-blitz-disco-gold.editorial: Disco Gold differs from Casino Gold: Cash Coins, outer-reel piggy banks and Free Spinz mode choice are central here rather than a Bonus Game Multiplier meter growing in the base game.

features.title: Cash Coins and Piggy Banks
features.description: Coins carry x0.5–x25 values; special Minor/Major/Mega can award a large prize, while two piggy banks double the current collection.

features.title: Gold Piggy
features.description: A random golden-piggy-bank appearance adds a separate prize; this should not be confused with regular Cash Collect.

features.title: Three Free Spinz modes
features.description: Scatters open a choice of Blitz, regular Free or Mystery Spinz, each with its own award and multiplier structure.

intro: Piggy Heist brings a robbery story to six reels. All coins enter the Safe Box even without Collect; opening the safe triggers Hold’n Spin with three attempts and a counter reset after every new coin.

The Stethoscope Wild Meter charges from special Scatters and gradually unlocks different Wilds: multipliers, expanding, sticky, walking and Mega Wilds. Unlike the bonus counter, this meter does not reset.
playn-go-piggy-heist.editorial: This is not another Piggy Blitz: it has a persistent meter of different Wilds and an optional Gamble after Hold’n Spin. Building the Safe Box and risking an already collected win are separate decisions.

features.title: Safe Box and Hold’n Spin
features.description: Coins collect in the safe without a mandatory Collect; filling it starts three re-spins, and every new Coin resets the counter.

features.title: Stethoscope Wild Meter
features.description: The meter unlocks multiplier, expanding, sticky, walking and 2×2 Mega Wilds while retaining charge between spins.

features.title: Gamble after the safe
features.description: The prize can be collected or risked up to four times: Multiplier Coins increase the payout, while too many Cop Coins lose the entire amount risked.

intro: Pilgrim of Dead uses a familiar book structure: three or more Tomb Scatters trigger Free Spins and reveal a Special Expanding Symbol selected from regular symbols before entry.

During Free Spins, the selected symbol can fill a whole reel when enough matches are present. Its special positions persist in the bonus, while reassignment of a special symbol follows the game's own rules.
playn-go-pilgrim-of-dead.editorial: Pilgrim of Dead is closer to classic book mechanics than Gold Re-Spins: its main decisions concern Special Expanding assignment rather than coin accumulation.

features.title: Tomb Scatter
features.description: Three or more tomb symbols trigger the bonus and determination of the special expanding symbol.

features.title: Special Expanding Symbol
features.description: The selected regular symbol can expand across a whole reel during Free Spins when enough matches are present.

features.title: Bonus sticky logic
features.description: Special golden symbols retain their role throughout the sequence, while choosing a different symbol is limited by bonus rules.

intro: Pimped is a line slot in which three or more Dollar Scatters trigger Win Spins: a bonus sequence guaranteeing at least one winning combination on every spin.
New Dollar Scatters during Win Spins can extend the sequence by two spins at a time, but total duration is capped at twenty. A separate card risk game is available after individual wins.
playn-go-pimped.editorial: Win Spins is the key term here and should not automatically become regular Free Spins: the mode's distinction is a guaranteed winning combination on every turn.

features.title: Win Spins
features.description: Three Dollar Scatters trigger guaranteed winning spins; each contains at least one paying combination.

features.title: Retrigger up to 20 turns
features.description: New Dollar Scatters during the bonus add two spins at a time until the specified sequence limit.

features.title: Card risk game
features.description: After a qualifying win, a card's colour or suit can be predicted in an attempt to increase the current amount.

intro: Piranha Pays displays a Piranha Trail: a predatory fish moves through positions, advancing a separate route. Beside it sits a multiplier jar, whose multiplier is not attached to a particular reel.
Two to three Scatters or a Piranha Wild together with two Scatters can open an Instant Prize; the game also has separate Fish Tank Prizes beyond regular Wild combinations.
playn-go-piranha-pays.editorial: Piranha Pays differs from Mega Don: its main references are the fish Trail and a separate multiplier meter. Instant Prize and Fish Tank are standalone events rather than regular Free Spins.

features.title: Piranha Trail
features.description: The fish advances along its own route, with its position tied to additional opportunities in the current round.

features.title: Multiplier Jar
features.description: A separate jar displays a multiplier capable of activating independently of a particular reel.

features.title: Instant and Fish Tank Prizes
features.description: Scatter combinations with a Piranha Wild can trigger an Instant Prize; Fish Tank offers a separate bonus award.

intro: Planet Fortune runs on five reels and 40 lines. The Wild Robot substitutes for regular symbols and also triggers ten Free Spins when three or more robots appear.
Magnetic Mayhem sometimes joins two neighbouring reels for an extra spin. Synchronised reels display large 2×2 or 3×3 symbol blocks, while bonus Wild Robots stay on the grid.
playn-go-planet-fortune.editorial: Planet Fortune has two different development paths: Magnetic Mayhem rearranges reels on one extra spin, while Wild Robots become sticky during Free Spins and keep operating throughout the sequence.

features.title: Magnetic Mayhem
features.description: Neighbouring reels spin together, forming 2×2 or 3×3 mega-symbols instead of stopping independently.

features.title: Robot Free Spins
features.description: Three or more Wild Robots trigger ten free spins; robots lock on the grid during the bonus.

features.title: 40 lines
features.description: Regular payouts come from three to five matching symbols on fixed lines, while Wild Robots substitute for standard symbols.

intro: Play'n GO Buffalo of Wealth starts on a 5×4 grid where random Wilds can contain x2 or x3 multipliers. Three Scatters trigger Free Spins, during which hidden extra rows gradually open.
New bonus Scatters do more than extend the sequence: they unlock reel height level by level, up to 5×8. Animal-symbol stacks remain part of the regular combination model.
playn-go-playn-go-buffalo-of-wealth.editorial: Buffalo of Wealth differs from typical animal slots through accumulating reel expansion. Bonus progress is measured by unlocked rows from 5×4 to 5×8 rather than one isolated Wild replacement.

features.title: Random Wilds x2/x3
features.description: Wilds with x2 or x3 multipliers can appear in the base game, enhancing qualifying combinations.

features.title: Expansion up to 5×8
features.description: Three Scatters open the bonus, while new Scatters gradually unlock hidden rows above the standard 5×4 grid.

features.title: Stacked animal symbols
features.description: Wolves, buffaloes and other high-paying animals can land in stacks, filling several positions at once.

intro: Play'n GO Mole Digger connects Hold’n Win with three Feature Pots: BOOST, MYSTERY and COLLECT. Coloured gems fill the corresponding pot and can enhance the next bonus.
Mine Carts appear randomly beneath one to five reels and collect visible gemstone values. Hold’n Win itself triggers through six Gems, filled pots or a special Gem with guaranteed enhancements.
playn-go-playn-go-mole-digger.editorial: Mine Carts and Hold’n Win should not be confused: carts collect base-game values, while Feature Pots set successive Mystery → Boost → Collect enhancements within the bonus.

features.title: Feature Pots
features.description: Red, green and blue Gems fill MYSTERY, BOOST and COLLECT; bonus effects apply specifically in the order Mystery, Boost, Collect.

features.title: Mine Cart Cash Collect
features.description: In the base game, one to five carts can collect Gem money values from the reels directly above them.

features.title: Hold’n Win
features.description: The bonus starts with three re-spins and replenishes with a new Gem; a full grid is tied to the Grand award.

intro: Wrappin' Gold brings a stolen-gem hunt into a five-reel Egyptian adventure. Triggering Symbols collect in the base game and open different features, so bonus behaviour depends on the accumulated symbol type.
A separate Bonus Spins mode uses its own Scatters and can extend. Khufu the mummy, Cleo and the sun god Ra are characters in this feature set rather than different versions of one image.
playn-go-playn-go-wrappin-gold.editorial: Wrappin' Gold should be read as a sequence of different trigger events rather than importing the later Wrappin' More Gold's mechanics. Confirmed materials for the first game provide no basis to invent additional prize tiers.

features.title: Triggering Symbols
features.description: Special symbols collected in the base game activate different game features rather than one general bonus.

features.title: Bonus Spins
features.description: The bonus sequence triggers through its own Scatters and can extend; it should remain distinct from regular triggering-symbol collection.

features.title: Egyptian chase
features.description: Khufu pursues stolen gems, while the presentation accompanies the story with separate mummy and Scatter events.

intro: Potion of Madness ties Scatter count to three different outcomes. One Scatter turns Dr J into Wilds on the grid, two open a Re-Spin with Sticky Wilds, and three or more trigger Free Spins.
During Free Spins, the grid expands to 5×6 with 40 lines. All Dr J symbols become Wilds, while some Wilds can expand vertically along a reel.
playn-go-potion-of-madness.editorial: Counting Scatters matters in Potion of Madness: one provides transformation, two a sticky Re-Spin, and three a bonus with different geometry. These are three separate modes rather than stronger versions of one Wild.

features.title: Transformation
features.description: The first Scatter transforms Dr J symbols into Wilds to form additional combinations.

features.title: Sticky Wild Re-Spins
features.description: Two Scatters trigger re-spins with locking Wilds, continuing until new Wilds stop appearing.

features.title: Free Spins 5×6
features.description: Three Scatters expand the grid to five reels of six symbols and forty lines; Dr J turns entirely Wild.

intro: Primal Rampage is a compact three-reel slot where Rage Symbols and a Vault control events. Three Rage Symbols trigger the Primal Wheel, selecting the next bonus scenario.
Kong Quest and King Spin use different Free Spins rules: one changes reel appearance and size as a city is destroyed, while the other interacts with locked safes.
playn-go-primal-rampage.editorial: Primal Rampage deliberately differs from large cluster grids: everything centres on three reels, a safe and a wheel. Kong Quest and King Spin should not be described as identical bonuses.

features.title: Rage Symbols
features.description: Collected rage symbols lead to the Primal Wheel; three symbols trigger bonus-event selection.

features.title: Primal Wheel
features.description: The wheel distributes awards between bonus variants, including Kong Quest and King Spin.

features.title: Vault and bonus scenarios
features.description: Safes participate in separate winning events, while Kong Quest and King Spin change reels and safe operation differently.

intro: Prism of Gems uses five main reels and an upper MULTIPLIER REEL. Centre reels can split symbols and grow up to seven high, raising Dynamic Payways to 3087 ways.

Winning combinations disappear and trigger cascades; on the horizontal row, a position's multiplier increases with every cascade of its corresponding reel, up to x7. Combining three upper multipliers can yield x343.
playn-go-prism-of-gems.editorial: Unlike Perfect Gems, Prism of Gems ties multipliers to horizontal-row positions. Upper-symbol and particular-reel participation affect the win, so a cascade alone does not mean an overall x343.

features.title: Dynamic Payways up to 3087
features.description: Reels 2–4 can expand to seven symbols when gems split beneath the upper horizontal row.

features.title: MULTIPLIER REEL
features.description: After a cascade, the multiplier above the corresponding reel increases up to x7; successfully applied together, the multipliers multiply.

features.title: Free Spins with a meter
features.description: Three, four or five Scatters award 10, 15 or 20 spins; accumulated upper multipliers persist, while every new Scatter adds two.

intro: Prissy Princess uses towers as part of a cascade system: successful combinations destroy them, new symbols fall into free positions, and each destroyed tower removes one Treasure Chest lock.
Five opened locks award a random prize. Beyond the chest, Dragon's Breath can add Wilds after a non-winning spin, while a reel completely filled with knights triggers Dragon's Pride.
playn-go-prissy-princess.editorial: Prissy Princess should not be reduced to standard Free Spins. Its main cycle is tower destruction and Treasure Chest, while extra dragon events respond differently to no wins and knight stacks.

features.title: Treasure Chest
features.description: Destroying five towers removes five locks, after which the chest reveals a random prize award or a multiplier on tower wins.

features.title: Dragon's Breath and Pride
features.description: After an empty spin, the dragon can turn up to three symbols Wild; a knight stack on a reel triggers a large stacked Wild.

features.title: Tournament
features.description: One Banner Scatter of each type triggers tournament-participant selection and a prize according to the place achieved.

intro: Prosperity Palace uses five reels and ten lines. The Jade Dragon substitutes for regular symbols, while three Golden Buddha Scatters anywhere trigger ten Free Spins.
During Free Spins, Buddha also gains a Wild function alongside the Jade Dragon. A separate card Gamble Game allows the win to be risked through a card-colour or suit prediction.
playn-go-prosperity-palace.editorial: The Asian theme does not hide a simple rule set here: regular ten-line play, a specific dragon Wild and a Golden Buddha bonus. This structure should not be overloaded with mechanics from other Palace slots.

features.title: Ten lines
features.description: Winning combinations form on ten fixed lines, while the Jade Dragon substitutes for standard symbols.

features.title: Golden Buddha Free Spins
features.description: Three Golden Buddha symbols trigger ten free spins; during the bonus, Buddha also helps combinations as a Wild.

features.title: Gamble Game
features.description: After an eligible win, a card's colour or suit can be predicted in an attempt to increase it before the next spin.

intro: Puebla Parade centres on dancing Wilds on an expanding playing grid. Two Wild dancers can join and create a multiplier moving between reels with the pair.
The playing area can grow from five reels of four positions to five of seven. Free spins have a separate mariachi track, but the bonus's main mechanic remains Wilds and grid expansion.
playn-go-puebla-parade.editorial: This is not a standard festive slot with stationary Wilds: dancer movement, a combined multiplier and increased position count change its winning structure.

features.title: Dancing Wilds
features.description: Wild characters move across the reels and substitute for regular symbols.

features.title: Joining and multiplier
features.description: Two Wild dancers can join to form a multiplier that continues moving around the grid.

features.title: Grid expansion
features.description: The playing area grows from 5×4 to 5×7, adding extra combination positions.

intro: Queen's Day Tilt is a 3×3 grid requiring two or three matching symbols vertically or horizontally for a win. The Queen acts as a Wild and can appear after a non-winning spin.
A full clear opens Queen's Day with five free spins and an initial x2 multiplier. Successes by both knights increase it, while Tilt sometimes removes the last symbol to finish a clear.
playn-go-queens-day-tilt.editorial: Tilt and Game of Accession operate under different rules here. The former finishes an almost-cleared grid, while the latter stages a separate contest between red and blue knights.

features.title: Tilt
features.description: When one symbol remains after clearing, a random Tilt can remove it and open Queen's Day.

features.title: Game of Accession
features.description: Wins by both knights trigger a respin with a side choice; a correct choice awards an x2 multiplier.

features.title: Queen's Day
features.description: Completely clearing the grid awards five Free Spins starting at x2; new clears can extend the sequence.

intro: Ra's Reckoning uses a 6×5 grid with cascading cluster wins: connected symbols disappear, new ones fall from above and can continue the chain.

After a cluster, the special Mega Drop event removes other regular symbols of the same type across the grid, even if they did not belong to the original winning group. The conflict between Ra and Apep shapes these chains' development.
playn-go-ras-reckoning.editorial: Unlike the classic Egyptian line series, covering one symbol type across the whole grid matters here; Mega Drop should not be reduced to a regular cascade.

features.title: Clusters on a 6×5 grid
features.description: Winning groups of connected symbols are removed, after which new ones fill the empty cells.

features.title: Mega Drop
features.description: After a cluster lands, other regular symbols of the matching type are also cleared across the entire grid.

features.title: Continuing cascades
features.description: Every new clear can form new clusters without starting a separate independent spin.

intro: The original Rabbit Hole Riches runs on a compact 3×3 grid. The White Rabbit opens different bonus branches through Rabbit Hole rather than one universal Wild sequence.
Tower Power offers a tower choice and compares its points against its rival; Queen's Army turns the Queen of Hearts into a Wild and raises the multiplier for every Free Spins win.
playn-go-rabbit-hole-riches.editorial: Court of Hearts' cascading expanding Wilds should not be carried into the original. This is a separate 3×3 game with towers, side selection and Queen's Army.

features.title: Rabbit Hole Bonus
features.description: The White Rabbit can open one of the standalone bonus branches.

features.title: Tower Power
features.description: The player selects a tower; a points victory awards an x2 multiplier, while a tie starts another selection round.

features.title: Queen's Army Free Spins
features.description: Eight spins with the Queen of Hearts as a Wild and a multiplier increasing after winning lines.

intro: Rabbit Hole Riches: Court of Hearts expands to five cascading reels. Cheshire Cat, Caterpillar and Dormouse operate in Rabbit Hole Bonus, each with distinct abilities.
Cheshire Cat moves an expanding Wild after winning cascades; Caterpillar creates three to seven Wilds, while Dormouse forms a Mega Wild up to 4×3. The Free Spins multiplier increases after wins.
playn-go-rabbit-hole-riches-court-of-hea.editorial: The sequel moves the adventure to the Queen's court, but its main difference from the original is mechanical: new cascades and three distinct White Rabbit bonuses.

features.title: Cheshire Cat
features.description: An expanding Wild changes reels after winning cascades until the chain ends.

features.title: Caterpillar and Dormouse
features.description: Caterpillar smoke adds 3–7 Wilds; Dormouse creates a growing Mega Wild up to 4×3.

features.title: Queen's Free Spins
features.description: Three Scatters open nine spins, while extra Scatters enhance the starting multiplier.

intro: Rage to Riches uses a special bonus-star collection. A star requires the sequence 10, J, Q, K and A spread across the reels. Five stars open a monster building-destruction bonus.
Three girl symbols on the first three reels trigger free spins. If three consecutive spins produce no win, the monster can activate a respin; stars do not collect at that point.
playn-go-rage-to-riches.editorial: The slot has two independent bonus routes: star accumulation differs from the Free Spins trigger. The star collection also operates separately for each bet size.

features.title: Five bonus stars
features.description: A 10/J/Q/K/A sequence across five reels adds a star; five open a building-destruction bonus.

features.title: Girls' Free Spins
features.description: Three girls on reels 1–3 trigger a free-spin sequence.

features.title: Monster respin
features.description: Three consecutive empty bonus spins can trigger special monster intervention.

intro: Raging Rex uses a 6×4 grid with 4096 ways to win. When a large Wild dinosaur occupies reel 2–6, Rampage triggers with movement onto neighbouring reels and respins.
Three or more Meteor Scatters trigger Raging Spins. Wild Hunt enhances regular Rex Wilds with multipliers, while Primal Rage places a large dinosaur on a random reel on every bonus spin.
playn-go-raging-rex.editorial: The original's main character is one walking T-Rex. Hatchling Mania and Jurassic Mayhem belong to Raging Rex 2 and should not be described as first-game features.

features.title: Rampage
features.description: A Stacked Rex Wild moves right to left towards the first reel, providing respins as it moves.

features.title: Wild Hunt
features.description: During Raging Spins, the Rex Wild receives multipliers that can combine in one combination.

features.title: Primal Rage
features.description: A large Rex Wild appears on one of reels 2–6 on every bonus spin.

intro: Raging Rex 2 retains the 6×4 grid and 4096 ways but adds dinosaur hatchlings. The bonus offers Primal Fury, Hatchling Mania or Jurassic Mayhem.
Primal Fury centres on a walking Rex and hatchlings it leaves behind; Hatchling Mania locks moving Wild hatchlings with possible x2 and x3 multipliers. Jurassic Mayhem joins both Wild families.
playn-go-raging-rex-2.editorial: The original Wild Hunt should not be copied here. The second game introduces hatchlings as a separate mechanic and offers the mixed Jurassic Mayhem mode.

features.title: Primal Fury
features.description: Rex walks across the reels during Free Spins, leaving Wild hatchlings behind.

features.title: Hatchling Mania
features.description: Hatchlings become Sticky Walking Wilds and can carry x2 or x3 multipliers.

features.title: Jurassic Mayhem
features.description: Combines moving Wilds and features from both preceding bonus branches.

intro: Raging Rex 3 unfolds on a 6×4 grid with 4096 ways to win: the large Rex Wild walks right to left, and hatchlings can appear beside it.
Three to six Scatters award 7, 9, 11 or 13 Free Spins. Before the bonus, the player chooses one of three standalone modes: Feeding Frenzy, Hatchling Mania or Survival.
playn-go-raging-rex-3.editorial: The third Raging Rex is more than previous games' free spins. Three different Scatter scenarios follow: a hunt with Frenzy Meter, moving Sticky Wild hatchlings or a separate Survival grid. The overall figure of 4096 applies to the base grid rather than Survival's twelve cells.

features.title: Rex Re-Spins
features.description: Rex appearing triggers one to five re-spins according to its starting reel 2–6. Each step moves right to left as a Stacked Wild without substituting for Scatter.

features.title: Feeding Frenzy
features.description: A prey dinosaur type is selected at the bonus start. If Rex meets its target on its reel, the Frenzy Meter fills and Rex receives a multiplier for the current spin.

features.title: Hatchling Mania
features.description: Separate Rex Hatchling Wilds lock and move between reels. Some carry x2 or x3 multipliers; the large Rex does not participate here.

features.title: Survival
features.description: Instead of regular reels, 12 separate positions appear around a central 2×2 Rex collector. Three lives start the mode, a prize symbol replenishes them, and filling the Bone Meter upgrades values.

intro: Rainforest Magic is a tropical Play’n GO video slot with five reels and 25 lines, where animal symbols appear alongside Mystery Symbols and a jaguar Wild.
All Mystery Symbols landing on one spin reveal the same symbol. Three or more jaguar Wilds trigger Free Spins with a separate moving Mystery Reels mechanic.
playn-go-rainforest-magic.editorial: Rainforest Magic has two different random-reveal layers. Mystery Symbols can appear on a regular spin and simultaneously become one symbol, while a pre-bonus flower sets the selected Mystery Reels count during Free Spins. Rainforest Magic Bingo is a separate game whose parameters are not used here.

features.title: Mystery Symbols in the base game
features.description: Mystery symbols can appear on any spin. After the reels stop, every such position on that spin turns into the same game symbol.

features.title: Jaguar Wild
features.description: The jaguar Wild substitutes for regular symbols in winning lines. Three or more simultaneous Wilds activate free spins.

features.title: Free Spins with a flower choice
features.description: At bonus entry, starting free spins equal twice the Wild count on the grid. One of four flowers then determines one to four Mystery Reels.

features.title: Moving Mystery Reels
features.description: During Free Spins, whole Mystery Symbol stacks change positions and reveal the same symbol after stopping, extending the regular Mystery mechanic.

intro: Rally 4 Riches centres on three main reels and a separate bonus reel to the right: it adds multipliers, nudges Wilds or sends the player into a race.
In The Race, the participant moves around a 24-cell board. Finishing position changes the award: regular prizes, special spins or access to Jackpot Bonus Game.
playn-go-rally-4-riches.editorial: The separate bonus reel is Rally 4 Riches' main distinction from familiar three-reel classics. The figure 1000x should not be entered as the overall maximum win: it is the top of a separate Jackpot Bonus Game, whose access depends on bonus progression. Play’n GO's press release of June 10, 2020 mentions five reels, but the game page itself describes three main reels plus an extra bonus reel; the record uses the game description.

features.title: Bonus reel
features.description: A separate bonus reel spins to the right of the main grid. It can award an x2, x3, x4, x5 or x10 multiplier for the current spin's win.

features.title: Nudging Wild
features.description: A three-position Stacked Wild substitutes for regular symbols. A special Nudging Wild can move the Wild on the grid and offer a chance to re-spin the bonus reel.

features.title: The Race: 24 cells
features.description: The race bonus follows a 24-cell route: a random number sets movement, money cells pay bet multipliers, and Nitro moves the car further.

features.title: Finish prizes
features.description: Fourth place awards board prizes; third awards Free Spins with guaranteed Nudging Wilds; second awards Win Spins with Nudging Wilds and a multiplier.
